finding.code_snippet:
# In code-checks pipeline stage:
- name: static-scan
  image: ...
  image_pull_policy: Always
  abort_on_failure: false  # LINE 15: scan failure does not block pipeline
  script: ...

# VERIFIED PRESENT (VULN-014, VULN-017, VULN-018):
# npm ci  (line 45)
# npm audit --audit-level=moderate  (line 49)
# detect-secrets (line 9) - re-enabled
# image_pull_policy: Always  (lines 17, 40)

# NOT PRESENT: .secrets.baseline file for detect-secrets comparison
finding.preliminary_assessment: The CI/CD pipeline configuration correctly implements VULN-014 (npm ci + npm audit), VULN-017 (detect-secrets re-enabled), and VULN-018 (image_pull_policy Always). However, the static-scan step has abort_on_failure:false, allowing the pipeline to continue even when the SAST scan finds vulnerabilities. This means vulnerabilities detected by static analysis do not block code from progressing to artifact signing and deployment. Additionally, detect-secrets step is re-enabled (VULN-017 fix) but .secrets.baseline file does not exist in the repository root — without a baseline file, detect-secrets may generate false positives or fail to properly compare against known safe patterns. Container images use version tags (not SHA256 digests), leaving them vulnerable to tag reassignment attacks.

patterns_observed: VULN-014 verified: npm ci (line 45) and npm audit --audit-level=moderate (line 49) present
VULN-017 verified: detect-secrets step enabled (line 9) but .secrets.baseline missing
VULN-018 verified: image_pull_policy Always on both image-based steps (lines 17, 40)
abort_on_failure:false on static-scan — security scan does not block build
Container image tags not pinned by SHA256 digest
Multiple steps disabled (when: false) — intentional per code-checks-only pipeline design
sign-artifact steps re-enabled but key management not visible in YAML

false_positives.rationale: Steps are intentionally disabled per code-checks-only pipeline architecture; deployment handled separately
Grep scan found no hardcoded API keys, tokens, or passwords in the pipeline YAML

analysis.coverage_assessment: Complete — full .pipeline-config.yaml analyzed. All VULN fix annotations verified against implementation. Secret scanning and image pinning gaps identified.

for_inquisitor: Change abort_on_failure to true on static-scan step — or document exception with risk acceptance sign-off
Pin container images by SHA256 digest instead of version tags
Verify sign-artifact key management — confirm signing keys are in secure credential store, not inline
